```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, dpi = 90, dev = "png", out.width = "100%")
options(width = 100)
all_times <- list() # store the time for each chunk
knitr::knit_hooks$set(time_it = local({
  now <- NULL
  function(before, options) {
    if (before) {
      now <<- Sys.time()
    } else {
      res <- difftime(Sys.time(), now)
      all_times[[options$label]] <<- round(lubridate::as.duration(res))
    }
  }
}))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(time_it = TRUE)
```

# Load packages

```{r load-pkg}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(ggplot2)
})

if (interactive()) {
  n_workers <- 16
} else {
  n_workers <- as.integer(params$threads)
}
RhpcBLASctl::blas_set_num_threads(n_workers)
set.seed(123)
```





# Session info

```{r session-info}
print("Run times of chunks:")
chunktimedf <- rbind(
  tibble::tibble(chunk="Total", time=purrr::reduce(all_times, `+`)), 
  tibble::tibble(chunk=names(all_times), time=lubridate::as.duration(unlist(all_times)))
)
print(chunktimedf, n=Inf)

sessionInfo()
```
